title: Revenue Receipts Tax Revenue Receipts
definition: Revenue receipts are those government receipts which neither create any liability nor cause any reduction in assets. Tax revenue receipts comprise compulsory payments made by individuals and corporations to the government without direct quid pro quo benefits, forming the backbone of the Union and State consolidated funds.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both UPSC Prelims (distinguishing between revenue and capital receipts, direct vs indirect taxes, tax buoyancy) and Mains GS Paper III (Fiscal federalism, tax reforms, GST, and resource mobilization).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Revenue Receipts Tax Revenue Receipts.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basics of Government Budgeting and Public Finance
Constitutional provisions under Article 265 and Part XII
